info.name: Replace picklist values for a global picklist

items.docs: Schedules or executes replacement of picklist values for the specified global picklist. You can specify either `id`, `display_value`, or both for `old_value` and `new_value`. If both are provided, the system validates them for consistency. The `from` (old) value can be non-existent in the current picklist, but the `to` (new) value must be in the **used** state of the picklist option.

info.name: Get picklist values which is in replace scheduler

items.docs: Retrieves picklist values that are currently being replaced through a replace scheduler for the given global picklist ID.

info.name: To get the fields associated with a global picklist

params.name: per_page
params.description: Number of records per page. Default and maximum: 200.

params.name: include_inner_details
params.description: Comma-separated list of nested details to include (e.g., `module.plural_label,module.module_name,layouts.status`). Allowed values: module.plural_label, module.module_name, layouts.status.

items.docs: Retrieves associations of picklist values with modules, fields, and layouts for a given global picklist ID.
